summary: A 48 dp tab bar of equal-width tabs from a static list of labels: a tap sets `selected` to the tab's index; the underline slides to the tapped tab while the labels cross-fade to `color`.

labels.doc: The tab labels, e.g. ["Day", "Week", "Month"]; each is also its tab's accessibility label

selected.doc: The selected index (0-based). Bind a document variable so panels can follow it; the bar animates the change itself (the underline slides, the labels cross-fade)

color.doc: Selected label and underline; unselected labels are muted

pitfalls: labels is static: the tabs are generated when the document is built ($each), and their number is the local n ({"$count": "labels"}); the selection is the runtime part

The motion is an animated local s = {"value": "@selected", "anim": 0.25}: it eases to the new index at paint time, and everything visible reads s, not @selected (the tap still sets @selected at once, so panels can switch immediately)
Each tab's highlight is a second, coloured copy of its label over the muted one, with graphicsLayer alpha 1 - min(1, abs(s - i)): 1 on the selected tab, 0 elsewhere, a cross-fade while s moves
The underline is one 2 dp canvas under the row: a rect from s * componentWidth() / n to (s + 1) * componentWidth() / n, so it slides between tabs
Mono themes have no motion: s is @selected, the underline and the highlight jump
Show the matching panel with the same alpha expression on stacked panels (or visibility); the tab bar does not switch content by itself
